LSPU-LB ACADEMIC PROGRAMS: OVERVIEW
Laguna State Polytechnic University - Los Banos Campus (LSPU-LB) offers 23 degree programs across 8 colleges. All programs are four-year programs.

Colleges and the programs they offer:
- College of Arts and Sciences (CAS): Bachelor of Science in Psychology
- College of Business Administration and Accountancy (CBAA): Bachelor of Science in Business Administration - Major in Marketing Management; Bachelor of Science in Accountancy; Bachelor of Science in Business Administration - Major in Financial Management
- College of Computer Studies (CCS): Bachelor of Science in Computer Science - Major in Intelligent Systems; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Major in Animation and Motion Graphics; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Major in Web and Mobile Application Development; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Major in Service Management Program
- College of Criminal Justice Education (CCJE): Bachelor of Science in Criminology
- College of Fisheries (CF): Bachelor of Science in Fisheries

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_789
SECTION: STUDENT ORGANIZATIONS AT LSPU-LB (OVERVIEW)
STUDENT ORGANIZATIONS AT LSPU-LB (OVERVIEW)
Source: campus information supplied by the maintainer (September 2026); not from the Handbook or Citizen's Charter.
Campus-wide: the Supreme Student Council (SSC), the main student government.
Named organizations: Legion of Lures Esports (LURES), Psychology Society (College of Arts and Sciences), Ka-Peer Yu Organization (peer support, working with the Guidance and Counseling Unit), EsKultura (cultural and arts, with Himig EsKultura and Likha EsKultura), Ritmo EsKultura (official dance club), and Bay Breeze Group of Publications (campus publication).
Each of the 8 colleges also has its own student council, including the CCS Student Council (CCS-SC), and the colleges have their own student organizations. Full membership lists were not supplied.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_797
SECTION: STUDENT COUNCILS AT LSPU-LB: SUPREME STUDENT COUNCIL AND THE EIGHT COLLEGE COUNCILS
STUDENT COUNCILS AT LSPU-LB: SUPREME STUDENT COUNCIL AND THE EIGHT COLLEGE COUNCILS
Source: Student Handbook Chapter 5, Article 2, Sec. 3 (SSC definition); campus information supplied by the maintainer (September 2026).
Yes. All 8 colleges (CAS, CBAA, CCS, CCJE, CF, CFND, CIHT and CTE) have their own student council, and there is one Supreme Student Council (SSC) that governs them at the campus level.
The Supreme Student Council is the student body duly managed and elected at large by the students themselves; its President sits on the Student Discipline Committee and its Federated President sits on the Board. At LSPU-LB it is the main campus-wide student government: it represents students and helps organize campus-wide activities, programs, and student initiatives.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_800
SECTION: CAMPUS EVENTS AT LSPU-LB (SUMMARY)
CAMPUS EVENTS AT LSPU-LB (SUMMARY)
Source: campus information supplied by the maintainer (September 2026). Event dates were supplied by the maintainer, are time-sensitive, and were not independently confirmed (status as of September 29, 2026).
Main events:
(1) ICAC-CAF, the sports and cultural competition among colleges. The 2026 campus level was held September 15-18, 2026, and the university-wide ICAC-CAF is scheduled for October 20-23, 2026 at the LSPU Santa Cruz Campus.
(2) The LSPU Founding Anniversary. The 73rd was celebrated with activities around November 26-28, 2025.
(3) College weeks: each college has its own festival week during the year, such as CCS Week and CTE Week.
Also, LURES took part in the 2026 February Fair esports competition.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_55
SECTION: PROGRAM: Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Sciences | College: College of Teacher Education (CTE) | Degree: Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd) | Major: Sciences
Regulatory basis (CHED): CMO No. 75, s. 2017 - Policies, Standards and Guidelines for Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd)
Program educational objectives (per this CMO):
- Demonstrate mastery of subject-area content and pedagogy sufficient to teach that subject effectively at the junior/senior high school level.
- Design and implement curricula and assessments responsive to the diverse needs of secondary learners.

Source notes: admission cutoff from the LSPU Admission Guidelines, 1st Semester AY 2026-2027, Annex A. Overview, skills, career outcomes, objectives, and board status reflect what the program's CMO and general knowledge of the field typically cover; they are not an official LSPU curriculum document.
